menuBar:
Use case: background-extraction.
Export a SINGLE production macOS MENU BAR TEMPLATE ICON from the attached approved NeaTree review board. Image is the exact approved artwork. Extract and faithfully reproduce the BLACK MENU-BAR GLYPH on the LOWER RIGHT, shown in the PALE preview swatch. Recreate that exact combined glyph at high resolution on a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, with precise clean edges.
Output one square 1024 x 1024 transparent PNG with the glyph centered, about 760px wide x 760px tall (aspect follows approved symbol), plenty of clear empty margins. One glyph only. No preview panels, no second white glyph, no app artwork, no labels, no text, no watermark, no surrounding frame, no shadows, no gray background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard baked into pixels.
Shape: same broad low FILLED mushroom head silhouette with TWO blunt chunky rounded horns, directly covering the top of a SINGLE vertical outlined FILE/DOCUMENT. The mushroom head is a low gently domed cap with outward gently rounded lower edges, its same horns merging into the shoulders. No hat, face, eyes, nose, mouth, glasses, spots or interior cutouts in the head. The outline page extends downward from beneath the head, narrower than head (about 60% of head width), with rounded lower corners. Small simple folded/dog-eared corner at upper right immediately below the head, exactly like approved preview. The document interior is OPEN TRANSPARENT negative space. The head overlaps/joins the document upper edge. The interior page fold strokes match page outline weight. Do not turn page into a solid stem. Preserve reference geometry faithfully; no stylistic reinterpretation. Strong even outlines scaled like 2pt at an 18pt overall icon, robust open spaces, crisp edges with subtle antialiasing only. PURE SOLID BLACK opaque artwork, no internal gradient, glass effects or texture. Real alpha transparency outside all strokes and fill including within the page. This template will automatically reverse to white in macOS; only supply BLACK glyph.
